hotel.name: The St. Regis. Shenzhen Bao An

verified_facts.text: The rooms and suites were designed by architect Andre Fu, pairing New York glamour with Shenzhen's energy.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by architect André Fu, harmonizes New York timeless glamour with Shenzhen dynamic energy

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Bar's Bay Mary cocktail blends lychee and osmanthus as the hotel's twist on the St. Regis Bloody Mary.
verified_facts.excerpt: including the Bay Mary – a distinctive blend of lychee and osmanthus that also serves as the hotel's unique twist on the iconic St. Regis Bloody Mary

verified_facts.text: At the center of The St. Regis Bar is a 4-meter-wide mural hand-painted by a local artist that tells stories of Bao'an.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the center of the bar, a 4-meter-wide mural hand-painted by a local artist tells the untold stories of Bao'an

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis evening ritual is performed in the Great Hall on the 35th floor every evening.
verified_facts.excerpt: This St. Regis ritual will be performed at the Great Hall at the 35th floor every evening at 6:00 PM.

verified_facts.text: The evening ritual is a sabrage ceremony celebrating the transition from day to evening.
verified_facts.excerpt: performs the sabrage ceremony to celebrate the transition from day to evening

verified_facts.text: Yan Ting serves classic Cantonese dishes reimagined with modern artistry, led by Chinese Executive Chef Watson Chen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Helmed by the acclaimed Chinese Executive Chef and culinary talent Watson Chen, Yan Ting serves classic Cantonese dishes that are reimagined with modern artistry

verified_facts.text: Yan Ting has a long interactive kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: A long interactive kitchen, combined with our authentic culinary philosophy, sets the stage for a dynamic dining experience

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Astor Terrace Bar is on an outdoor rooftop terrace with a cylindrical bar and views of the bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: The cylindrical bar serves as a visual focal point, while the outdoor seating area creates a relaxed and leisurely atmosphere. As guests savor their drinks, they can enjoy stunning views of the bay.

verified_facts.text: The Drawing Room in the lobby serves afternoon tea every afternoon as a tribute to Caroline Astor.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every afternoon, immerse yourself in our modern interpretation of Afternoon Tea, a tribute to the refined legacy of Caroline Astor from the early 1900s

verified_facts.text: Rooms feature dark oak parquet, dusty grey veneer and Carrara marble, with oriental-inspired timber screens and marquetry headboards.
verified_facts.excerpt: The rooms feature dark oak parquet, dusty grey veneer, and Carrara marble, with highlights like oriental-inspired timber screens, bronze and glass wall sconces, and intricate marquetry on the headboard

verified_facts.text: Floor-to-ceiling windows in the rooms frame views of the city or Qianhai Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling windows frame sweeping views of the city or Qianhai Bay

verified_facts.text: The Caroline Astor Suite is a bay-view suite with views of the bay, the Bay Glory Ferris wheel and the Bao'an coastal skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: the bay view suite at 90 sqm, offering breathtaking views of the azure bay, the Bay Glory Ferries wheel, and the coastal skyline

verified_facts.text: The hotel is in Bao'an District, Shenzhen.
verified_facts.excerpt: 1088 Xingye Road, Bao'an District, Shenzhen, Guangdong, China, 518101

verified_facts.text: Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport is about 20 km from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: SZX is located approximately 20.0 KM from the hotel

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Spa has four treatment rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: The four treatment rooms will offer an exquisite sanctuary

verified_facts.text: The hotel has one indoor pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, The St. Regis Shenzhen Bao'an has one Indoor pool on-site for hotel guests.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center has floor-to-ceiling windows with city views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling windows flood the space with natural light, offering stunning city views as you exercise.

verified_facts.text: St. Regis Butler Service is offered at the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy the St. Regis Butler Service, a personalized signature offering of the brand

verified_facts.text: Meeting spaces are on the 3rd floor with natural daylight and terraces, including the pillar-less Astor Ballroom.
verified_facts.excerpt: All meeting spaces are located on the 3rd floor of the building, featuring natural daylight and terraces. The 696 sqm pillar-less Astor Ballroom

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The St. Regis Shenzhen Bao'an.

verified_facts.text: Nearby attractions include OH Bay, Xiwan Mangrove Park, Nantou Ancient City and the Bay Opera of Shenzhen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Shenzhen Uniwalk Qianhai, OH Bay, Nantou Ancient City, Xiwan Mangrove Park, Bay Opera of Shenzhen and more are nearby

verified_facts.text: The hotel holds a Forbes Travel Guide Four Star rating for 2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: Forbes Travel Guide Four Star Rating for 2026

subjective.text: Each room showcases a refined urban mansion aesthetic.
subjective.reason: the hotel's own opinion or praise; keep out of facts
